name: Plenum
rationale: Plenum is the Latin word for a full assembly where every member is present and decides together, which is what the app does: three or four models sit, critique each other and reach one verdict, and then smaller agents carry out the work. It is short, plain, not a Meta or AI-lab name, and it has no close namesake in the AI council space. The only same-name software found is a workplace-safety product, a few consultancies and a research project, none of them a multi-model tool.

checked.result: chosen: no AI council product under this name found
checked.notes: Namesakes found: Plenum AI (plenumapps.com, workplace health and safety software that calls itself AI-infused), plenum AG (German management consultancy), Plenumsoft (Mexican software studio), Plenum Tech (Dubai IT company), and PLENUM (RISE research project on collaborative 3D factory workspaces). Also 'plenum' is a common building term (air plenum). Web search only; trademark registers (USPTO, EUIPO, UK IPO) were not checked.

checked.result: runner-up: crowded in AI, but in other niches
checked.notes: Tessera Labs (enterprise multi-agent AI that connects ERP systems, Foundation Capital-backed), a trust layer that traces AI-agent answers to evidence, a Tessera AI team-workspace mockup, Tessera/Axus Search ecosystem, and an app studio. None is a multi-model council, but the name is taken across several AI products. Word means a single tile of a mosaic: many pieces, one picture.

checked.result: ruled out: same-concept products already exist
checked.notes: Synode (MIT-licensed macOS and Windows desktop app: several AI models discuss a question as a council and a master model gives a verdict; near-identical concept), synod.run (multi-model coding agent with a 'Pope' synthesis model), a small Obsidian plugin called Synod (council of LLM agents), Synodic Software (Toronto AI developer-tools company), Synod.im (Matrix messenger), and the Anglican General Synod event app.

checked.result: ruled out: established AI and enterprise software names
checked.notes: Quorum public-affairs platform (Quorum Copilot and Quincy AI, used by more than 2,000 organisations, over half the Fortune 100, recent Enlightenment Capital investment), Quorum Software (energy industry, QAI chatbot). The Quorum enterprise blockchain was not searched here.
Concord (concord.app), an AI-native contract management platform with its Horizon release and Agreement Intelligence; claims 1,500+ companies and over a million users in different places.

checked.result: ruled out: crowded, including AI companies

checked.result: ruled out: AI contract and software names

checked.result: ruled out: same concept, several AI products
checked.notes: AI Roundtable (Opper: 200+ models debate and vote), RoundTable (desktop app: one question to up to four models with cross-critique), Roundtable Adaptive (ClawHub, consensus scoring), VIVE Roundtable (HTC group chat with AI experts), and a market-research platform.

checked.result: ruled out: known company and common phrase
checked.notes: CommonGround (3D avatar company that Apple reportedly acquired as TrueMeeting), plus a hackathon mediation app. Two-word phrase used by many products.

alternatives: Tessera: runner-up if the owner dislikes Plenum. Crowded in AI but not in the council niche.
Synod: fits the meaning best, but direct same-concept desktop apps already exist (Synode, synod.run), so it is not recommended.
